title: 第4章 以工代赈，折服皇帝
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林墨见她神色，便知自己说对了。

这些都是他融合原身记忆后，通过对方家传的精湛医术，推敲出来的。

他淡淡道：“将军的病，是寒气入体，伤了冲任二脉。”

“光靠内力压制，只会越来越严重。”

“以后运功前，可含一片炮制过的干姜，事后饮一碗当归红糖水。”

“虽不能根治，却能缓解七成痛苦。”

冷月脸色一阵红一阵白，惊疑不定地打量林墨。

这个年轻的太医……医术竟然高明到了这种地步？

她沉默了片刻，终于收回了按在剑柄上的手，语气也缓和了许多。

“……多谢林太医指点。”

她做了一个“请”的手势，态度比之前客气了不少。

“陛下还在等着，我们走吧。”

林墨心中暗笑。

你这娘们不是很傲吗？

嘿嘿，还不是被我三言两语就镇住！

他理了理有些褶皱的青色官袍，昂首挺胸地跟着冷月，走出暗阁。

再次踏入御书房，气氛已然不同。

刘烈高坐于龙椅之上，慕容雪侍立一旁。

帝后两人的目光，都聚焦在林墨身上。

一个，带着审视和怀疑。

一个，满是紧张和期待。

两名侍卫，持刀立于两侧，整个书房内弥漫着一股肃杀之气。

“放肆！看到圣上，还不跪下！”

刘烈身边的太监，厉声喝道。

林墨却仿佛没听见一般，只是平静地看着刘烈，不卑不亢地拱了拱手。

“臣，参见陛下，参见皇后娘娘。”

刘烈眉头一拧，眼中怒意一闪而过。

“大胆！见了朕为何不跪？！”

林墨微微一笑，朗声说道：“回陛下！”

“医者治人，如同治国。”

“若要治本，需以国宾之礼待之。”

“今日臣若跪下，便只是个唯唯诺诺的看病郎中，出不了奇策，救不了危局。”

“臣今日，是为陛下献救国之策，而非领罪而来。”

“所以……臣不能跪。”

好一个狂妄之徒！

刘烈怒极反笑。

他见过许多阿谀奉承的臣子。

也见过不少仗着战功，恃宠而骄的武将。

但还从未见过一个阶下之囚，敢在他面前如此嚣张狂傲！

他刚要发作，却看到一旁的慕容雪，对他轻轻摇了摇头，眼神中带着一丝恳求。

刘烈冷哼一声，终究还是把那股怒火，强行压了下去。

现在不是计较这些虚礼的时候。

他需要的是那个该死的《江南水患治灾策》！

Page (1/3)

Lin Mo saw her look and knew he was right.

These were all deduced through the superb medical skills inherited from the other party's family after merging his original body's memories.

He said calmly: "The general's illness is caused by cold air entering the body and damaging the Chong and Ren meridians."

"Just relying on internal force to suppress it will only get worse and worse."

"In the future, you can take a piece of processed dry ginger before exercising, and drink a bowl of angelica brown sugar water afterwards."

"Although it cannot cure the disease, it can relieve 70% of the pain."

Leng Yue's face turned red and white, and she looked at Lin Mo uncertainly.

This young imperial physician... is his medical skills so good?

She was silent for a moment, and finally took back her hand on the hilt of the sword, and her tone softened a lot.

"...Thank you, Doctor Lin, for your advice."

She made a "please" gesture and her attitude was much more polite than before.

"Your Majesty is still waiting, let's go."

Lin Mo smiled secretly in his heart.

Aren't you a very proud bitch?

Hehe, you were still calmed down by just a few words from me!

He straightened his wrinkled blue official robe, followed Leng Yue out of the dark pavilion with his head held high.

Stepping into the imperial study room again, the atmosphere was completely different.

Liu Lie sat high on the dragon chair, with Murong Xue standing beside him.

The eyes of both the emperor and the empress were focused on Lin Mo.

One, with scrutiny and suspicion.

One, full of tension and anticipation.

Two guards stood on both sides holding swords, and the whole study was filled with a chilling atmosphere.

"How presumptuous! Why don't you kneel down when you see the Holy One!"

The eunuch beside Liu Lie shouted sharply.

Lin Mo didn't seem to hear him. He just looked at Liu Lie calmly and held his hands in a neither humble nor overbearing manner.

"My lord, please see your majesty and the queen."

Liu Lie frowned, anger flashed in his eyes.

"Bold! Why don't you kneel down when you see me?!"

Lin Mo smiled slightly and said loudly: "Return to Your Majesty!"

"A doctor treats people as he governs a country."

"If we want to cure the root cause, we need to treat them with the courtesy of a state guest."

"If I kneel down today, I will be just a submissive doctor who can't come up with any clever ideas or save the crisis."

"Today, I am here to offer your majesty a plan to save the country, not to take a crime."

"So... I cannot kneel."

What an arrogant person!

Liu Lie was so angry that he laughed instead.

He has seen many flattering ministers.

I have also seen many generals who are proud of their military exploits and their favor.

But I have never seen a subordinate prisoner dare to be so arrogant and arrogant in front of him!

Just as he was about to have an attack, he saw Murong Xue on the side, shaking her head gently at him, with a hint of pleading in her eyes.

Liu Lie snorted coldly, and finally suppressed the anger.

Now is not the time to worry about these false gifts.

What he needs is the damn "Jiangnan Flood Control Strategy"!
